axis_v2_analytics_enabled.trigger: Independent optional analytics grant committed (consent.grant). Once per grant generation.

axis_v2_onboarding_completed.trigger: account_profile.complete_onboarding committed with profile_complete false->true. Repeat submissions/edits are not completions.

axis_v2_training_plan_proposed.trigger: PD2 preview candidate staged (mobile_training_generation.store.stage_candidate, preview operation). A proposal is not a plan.

axis_v2_training_plan_created.trigger: A training plan row committed by store.commit_plan (ai_*) or store.commit_general_plan (general). Idempotent replays emit nothing new.

axis_v2_workout_completed.trigger: workout_completion.complete_workout CREATED outcome committed (one canonical completion-day claim). ALREADY_COMPLETED/replay emits nothing.

axis_v2_coach_reply_completed.trigger: memory_manager.record_turn committed a non-interrupted assistant reply. No prompt, reply, topic or model data.

axis_v2_coach_mutation_applied.trigger: plan_mutation.apply_plan_mutation committed outcome=applied with actor=ai_coach. no_op, replayed, refused and undo are not counted. Nutrition WRITE value is NOT in the enum until that writer exists and is reviewed.

axis_v2_weekly_checkin_submitted.trigger: mobile_weekly_checkin.submission.submit committed a NEW check-in (created=true). Replays emit nothing. No answers.

axis_v2_feature_failed.trigger: store.record_failure committed a terminal generation failure. Closed feature/retryability only; no error text, codes or provider names.

axis_v2_app_opened.trigger: First authenticated foreground of a process under a valid grant.

axis_v2_app_resumed.trigger: Authenticated return to foreground after >=30 s in background under a valid grant.

axis_v2_screen_viewed.trigger: Coarse top-level screen change; consecutive duplicates suppressed. Never routes, arguments or extras.

axis_v2_onboarding_started.trigger: First actionable onboarding page shown under a valid grant.

axis_v2_onboarding_step_completed.trigger: Accepted advance from an onboarding step. No answers, permissions or errors.

axis_v2_training_plan_requested.trigger: Explicit plan-generation request accepted by the client. A request is never success.

axis_v2_plan_viewed.trigger: Plan screen showed an existing plan.

axis_v2_coach_message_sent.trigger: User sent a Coach message (explicit send). No content or length.

excluded_by_design.signup_started: Pre-auth collection is not approved; signup funnel is N/A.
excluded_by_design.signup_completed: No analytics consent can exist before an account exists; N/A.
excluded_by_design.client *_observed success events (v1): Client projections never count as committed backend success; superseded by server authority events.
excluded_by_design.food_log / nutrition contents: Nutrition contents are excluded; Nutrition WRITE events require separate review once the Coach Nutrition writer exists.
excluded_by_design.person/profile properties, $set, identif: No person profiles; no direct account identifiers.
excluded_by_design.device/OS/app/locale/timezone/network/sc: Not sent; server-mediated wire carries only the allowlist above.
